description: This file defines a custom exception class 'SesV2Exception' for handling errors related to the Amazon Simple Email Service v2 (SES V2) within the AWS SDK for PHP. It extends the generic 'AwsException' class from the AWS SDK.

classes.name: SesV2Exception
classes.description: A specific exception class used to handle errors in the SES V2 service interactions, extending the base AwsException class.
